topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I just found out that Alex, my best friend, is moving across the country. It’s a lot to take in. We’ve always said we’d stick together, no matter what. We’ve shared so much, from late-night talks to cheering each other through tough times. Now, I’m thinking about all the new friends Alex will make, the places they’ll see, and the experiences they’ll have. It’s a big change, and I can’t help but wonder how it will all play out. I guess it’s time to plan a goodbye that feels like a new beginning, not an end. There’s so much to figure out, but I’m determined to make this transition as smooth as possible for us both.
